# NanCrown

Last updated: 2026-11-06

> NanCrown is a custom cap and hat manufacturer with our own factories in Guangzhou and Dongguan, China. We are responsible for every order from paper pattern to final inspection, and every batch is checked by us. Minimum order: 50 pieces per style, colour and size. Samples take 7–15 days; bulk production takes 25–30 days after sample approval, plus shipping time.

## Verified company facts

- Founded in 2015, with more than 10 years of experience.
- About 2,000 m² of factory space, more than 30 employees, monthly capacity of more than 100,000 caps, and customers in more than 50 countries.
- We have our own factories in both Guangzhou and Dongguan. We provide embroidery, printing and other custom decoration, and arrange and check the work. Every batch is inspected.
- Minimum order: 50 pieces per style, per colour and per size. Adult and child sizes each require 50 pieces. Colours of the same style can reach a quantity tier together, but each colour and size must still meet the minimum; 100 pieces cannot be split into three colours.
- Standard single-logo physical sample: US$50 each, excluding shipping. More logo positions and complex designs are quoted separately. Sampling takes 7–15 days depending on style and requirements. The sample fee is refunded when 1,000 or more pieces of the same design are ordered.
- Bulk production normally takes 25–30 days after sample approval; shipping time is additional. Confirm the schedule for the specific quantity, style and processes.
- All quotations are EXW and exclude shipping, including sample quotations. Special fabrics, processes, hardware and packaging are quoted separately. Ask for a quote for the actual design and destination.
- Indicative price per cap, standard build (6-panel cotton twill, flat embroidered logo, one woven label), one style, ex-works Guangzhou:
  - 50–99 pieces: US$7.0–7.7
  - 100–299 pieces: US$4.3–5.7
  - 300–499 pieces: US$3.6–4.3
  - 500+ pieces: US$2.9–3.6
- Custom woven label: One custom woven label is included in the standard 6-panel cotton twill baseball cap price at every published tier, including 50–99 pieces; there is no additional standard-label setup charge. One label is also included in the standard sample. Extra labels, printed inside taping, hangtags and custom packaging are quoted separately. Other hat builds are quoted to their own specification.
- Quick-dry or breathable running-cap fabrics cost about US$0.5–1 more per cap than standard cotton twill for 50–100 pieces of the same style.
- Packing: 25 caps share one poly bag and go in one inner box; each export carton holds 4 inner boxes (100 caps). Individual bags or other custom packaging require separate packing confirmation and a quote.
- Third-party inspection is welcome. A live video call to view the workshop is available on request.
- Inquiry replies: within 1–2 business days.

## Styles and decoration

- Baseball caps, dad hats, snapbacks, 5-panel caps, trucker hats, bucket hats, visors, camp caps, running caps, golf caps, cadet caps, outdoor caps and winter hats.
- Flat embroidery, 3D puff embroidery, leather / PVC / woven patches, reflective logo prints and laser-cut ventilation.
- The thinnest part of 3D puff embroidery should be at least 2 mm, except pointed stroke endings. Logo suitability is confirmed from the artwork.
- Branding options include woven labels, printed inside taping, hangtags and packaging; confirm the specification in the quote.
